Name: Villager Begone (Removes Any Villager)
Author: stillmitsu
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

So you have a villager who lives rent free in your head and you wish they would just stop existing. Same.

Villager Begone gives you a checklist of every villager in the game. Tick whoever you want gone, click save, and they vanish. Invisible sprite, blank portrait, completely silent, removed from the social menu and calendar, and their name gets replaced with **REDACTED** in every line of dialogue, mail, secret note, and quest text. Works on vanilla AND modded content. No save file edits, fully reversible, drama free.

Tick one villager. Tick three. Tick all of them. Whatever serves the vibe.


[b][size=5]!! Heads up !![/size][/b]

This mod [u]does [/u][b][u]NOT[/u] [/b]actually delete the villager from your save file. Their NPC data still exists in the save. The mod just hides them everywhere, warps them off-map, silences them, and redacts their name from all readable text. [b]This is intentional and means the change is fully reversible. 😉 [/b](that means you can still get them to come back anytime)

[list]
[*]Your ticked villager will be at the [b]festival [/b]in spirit, [b][u]but you won't see them[/u][/b] because their sprite is invisible. There may be small visual oddities, like a dance partner moving around with nobody visible next to them. This is a known tradeoff.[/*]
[*][b]Heart Events and Cutscenes[/b] that feature them are auto-skipped. You see a brief flash of the event starting and then it cuts back to gameplay. The [u]event is marked as seen[/u] so it doesn't replay later.[/*]
[*]If you're already [b]married [/b]to a villager you tick, your spouse will disappear from the farmhouse. Their portrait, dialogue, and presence are all gone. The marriage technically [u]still exists[/u] in your save data, so you can untick them later and they come back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Generic Mod Config Menu installed.[/*]
[*]Download the Villager Begone zip from this page.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip directly into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder. You should now have two new folders inside the [b]Villager Begone[/b] folder: "[CP] Villager Begone" and "Villager Begone (Text Redaction)". [u]Both are required. Do not separate them.[/u][/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[*]From the title screen, click the gear icon to open Generic Mod Config Menu (or open Mod Options from inside the game).[/*]
[*]Find "Villager Begone" in the list.[/*]
[*]Tick the villager/s you want gone. Click Save & Close.[/*]
[/list]That's it. Changes take effect right after you save.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

Tick a villager and they get:
[list]
[*]Invisible sprite. Their character model is fully transparent.[/*]
[*]Blank portrait. No face in any dialogue box.[/*]
[*]Name replaced with [i]REDACTED[/i] in dialogue, mail, secret notes, and quest text.[/*]
[*]Removed from the social menu (no friendship tracking, no birthday reminders).[/*]
[*]Removed from the calendar.[/*]
[*]Removed from Perfection score, Winter Star draw, and Flower Dance. [u][b]So don't worry, removing them won't affect your game.[/b][/u][/*]
[*]Warped off the map continuously. They can't be clicked, can't block paths, can't trigger dialogue, can't wander into your screen.[/*]
[/list]Plus:
[list]
[*]Works on existing saves AND new saves.[/*]
[*]Covers vanilla game content AND mods (any modded dialogue or quest text loaded through SMAPI's content pipeline gets scanned).[/*]
[*]Configurable.[/*]
[*]Multi-select. Tick as many villagers as you want.[/*]
[*]Fully reversible. Untick them anytime and they come back exactly how they were.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (highly recommended, this is how you tick villagers in-game)[/*]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]The Stardew Valley modding community for the documentation and examples that helped me put this together.[/color][/*]
[/list]
